contract_term.value: 1 year initial term with options to extend for four additional 1-year renewal periods, total term not to exceed 5 years
contract_term.quote: The term of the agreement resulting from this RFP is to be for a period of one (1) year, with options to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for four (4) additional 1-year renewal periods for a total term not to exceed five (5) years collectively.

scope_of_deliverables.value: CMHC is seeking proposals for Reference Data Management (RDM) Services, divided into three streams: 1. Develop and Implement an Operating Model for RDM, 2. Adoption of RDM Governance and Policy, and 3. Implement a Sustainable Technical Solution.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The Three stream are: 1. Develop and Implement an Operating Model for Reference Data Management (RDM) 2. Adoption of RDM Governance and Policy 3. Implement a Sustainable Technical Solution

value: MTR. 1: Data Residency. CMHC Data, while at rest or in transit must stay within the geographical boundaries of Canada and accessed from within Canada.
MTR. 2: Data Security. Proponents must demonstrate that they have the required IT infrastructure in place to safeguard CMHC Data classified Protected B or higher, including personal information.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. Formula: Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points. Submission format: Pricing Form (Appendix B).
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the Pricing Form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has bid on, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points
